exact_statement: For every integer w>=4, set m=2^w,p=1/m,beta=1-p,n=mw and let f_w=1-2 product_(b=1..m)(1-A_w(x_b)) be the actual Boolean OR sign of disjoint width-w point conjunctions. For each coordinate i define epsilon_i=Inf_i, mu_i(T)=fhat(T+i)^2/epsilon_i, r_i(T)=fhat(T)^2+fhat(T+i)^2, and let bar_mu_i,bar_r_i be their pushforwards under T->|T|. Every epsilon_i=epsilon=2p beta^(m-1), I=2w beta^(m-1), and 0<=D2(bar_mu_i||bar_r_i)<=3+log2(w+1/2). Defining M=sum_i epsilon_i[log2(1/epsilon_i)-D2(mu_i||r_i)] and M_degree=sum_i epsilon_i[log2(1/epsilon_i)-D2(bar_mu_i||bar_r_i)], one has M_degree/I>=w-4-log2(w+1/2), hence M_degree/I>=w/2 for w>=32, while 0<=M<=B<=H<=6I for all w>=4. The exact discarded conditional refund is M_degree-M=sum_i epsilon_i sum_t bar_mu_i(t) D2(mu_i(.|t)||r_i(.|t)), and divided by I it is at least w/2-6 for w>=32. Thus no absolute K makes M_degree<=K I for all actual Boolean signs; no FEI disproof or obstruction to full function-specific row references is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cube, actual Boolean OR sign of independent point conjunctions
w>=4 integer; m=2^w; disjoint width-w blocks; all coordinates relevant
Normalized Fourier probabilities; entropy and KL in bits; ordinary physical influence
Coarsening is residual Fourier degree, not physical restriction or full-subset exchangeability
Complete normalized derivative and reference row laws; zero terms by continuity
refutes: There exists one finite absolute K such that the actual normalized derivative/reference refund coarsened to residual Fourier degree satisfies M_degree(f)<=K I(f) for every finite uniform-cube Boolean sign. This is a tested downstream shortcut, not an assertion attributed to A096 or A099.
